title: A game character wearing the equipment, one view
description: One full-body view of a supplied game character wearing the authoritative equipment, keeping that character's body, pose and camera. States the truthful synthetic-character context; only for synthetic renders.

body.subject: {{references_are}}. The first image is the target character in this view: preserve identity, build, proportions, limb lengths, pose and camera. The second image is the authoritative equipped costume; any later image is supporting detail
body.action: Fit {{items}} to the character, replacing the base clothing with the fully covering costume; keep the equipment design across bodies, changing only its fit. Keep shoulder, elbow and wrist positions and the feet spacing; close fingers only for grips. Equipment stays on the same body side as the camera rotates; occluded parts stay hidden
body.camera: {{view}}. One full-body character, one view, square frame, with consistent matching margins for the tallest and widest parts
body.style: The source image's background and camera, even diffuse lighting, worn matte materials, minimal shine
body.constraints: No second figure, spare pieces, labels, text, watermark or scene dressing

references_are.default: All references depict fictional adult video-game characters and equipment: synthetic engine renders, not photographs of real people
enum: All references depict fictional adult video-game characters and equipment: synthetic engine renders, not photographs of real people
references_are.description: the truthful provenance statement; this template is not for real-person references

items.description: every item with its side, e.g. shield on the LEFT forearm, spear in the RIGHT hand

view.default: The same view as the target character image
view.description: the camera direction and where each item shows in it

negatives: no change of pose or build
no equipment moved to face the camera

reference_image.description: the target character in this view: a synthetic game-character render, never for photographs of real people

image_references.description: the authoritative equipped costume first, then supporting detail; name any superseded design so it is ignored

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: count one body per image and check every item's side; identity, pose and fit stay unverified until measured

provenance.source: astra-1 crew shelf: the TITAN ImageGen workflow (titan-imagegen SKILL.md, 2026-09-26), its templates and encountered failures
provenance.note: generalised from one armour set to any equipment: the wearer-axis camera table, one physical piece per plate, the 3x2 turnaround order at one physical scale, isolation of a held object, and the synthetic-character provenance that cleared an image-service refusal
